        discriminant = b*b - 4*a*c
        
        if discriminant < 0:
            return [], {"error": "no_real_roots"}

        # Roots are (-b +/- sqrt_d) / (2a)
        root1_num = -b + sqrt_disc

                roots_list.append(r2)
            else:
                roots_list.append(r2)
                roots_list.append(r1)
